name: sessions-retro
description: Retrospective over pi session transcripts for one project: enumerate via the pi_sessions_list tool (parents + nested child subagent sessions), parallel cheap-model per-parent digests that also mine children for evidence, then a strong-model synthesis that grounds, merges and ranks a proposal board and writes the report note into ~/obsidian/pi_knowledge/sessions-retro/, returning its path. Read-only children except the report note; a human decides what to apply. See README.md for limits.

cwd.description: The project whose sessions to review, e.g. /Users/nietaki/repos/grr-fyi (pi stores them under ~/.pi/agent/sessions/--Users-nietaki-repos-grr-fyi--/ - absolute path with '/' replaced by '-')

maxSessions.description: Newest-N PARENT sessions to digest (capped at 16); each parent's child (subagent) transcripts ride along in its digest worker

noteDir.description: Vault directory for the report note (default /Users/nietaki/obsidian/pi_knowledge/sessions-retro)
